title: Sigma-table aligned rho v15n: report processing charged (348 Ir/report), alignment priced as a shipped function (1190 Ir step), probe executed on the counted object, claim 636201/5000

claims.statement: Analytic secp256k1 ECDLP claim at success >= 0.39: six-class (negation and GLV) parallel rho walk with a 2^16 report partition, priced from counted aarch64 listings at the protected C=1000. The step is 1190 Ir = 748 (unchanged point listing) + 442 (the alignment routine class_slot+even_y+row store, called unconditionally on the output x of every step, so no output is left unaligned). The report processor is 348 Ir per report (hash/route/compare/store) and is charged at 72663536154147236320473922943389966193 reports, the dp1 count ceil(arrivals/2); report work is NOT netted against the escape surcharge. W_time = 2^127.240158 and the claim is the smallest 1e-4 decimal covering W + 2e-5, proved in both directions in integer arithmetic. Success: 2643/6400 unconditional verified recoveries within the charged budget, CP-95 lower 0.402798 >= 0.39; scope is this fixture at CP-95 plus the disclosed random-map premise (pooled mu = 1.107), not a production certification. Equivariance is executed on the counted object (ctypes on the clang -O2 arm64 .dylib): 0 splits over 3000 orbit-partner comparisons, with a control arm splitting 2400/3000. Claim 636201/5000 is above the live frontier observed at build time (126.3469); this revision is a correctness repair, not a competitive bid. No production execution and no practical break are claimed.
